item.title: Kendall Jenner Pepsi Ad
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Media/Satire/Infiltration

Elevator Pitch: An anomalous version of the infamous Kendall Jenner Pepsi ad that iterates until it begins depicting the Foundation as the police and begins detailing containment procedures.

Central Narrative: DOGM OVIE format, we iterate through increasingly lurid, then occult iterations of the Pepsi ad, the artist, journalist, nature of the protest and police counter-measures, as well as the behavior of the Pepsi drinking officer, all change progressive until things becoming chillingly specific. All testing is ceased, an analyst from the Media Department who has watched the video 5000 times is put through a Loyalty Test, deemed non-compromised, left under surveillance. Some time later the SCP is reclassified to Euclid from Safe when a secondary -A effect is discovered where each playback has cast a sort of radiation, which has collided with several other SCPs and empowered them.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The thematically most vile, yet nihilistic, piece of media ever produced as a virulent media SCP, possible Chaos Insurgency attempt at infiltration.
